issues.harvest-stats/hx1: On /stats, when an earlier range's stats response arrives after a later one, the page shows the earlier range's results while the date fields show the newer range; triggered by changing the dates twice quickly with the first request slower.
issues.harvest-stats/hx2: On /stats, plants sharing a name are merged into one row of the weight-by-month table (grouped by name, not id) while Best plants lists them separately; triggered by creating two plants with the same name and logging harvests for both.
issues.harvest-stats/stale-summary-on-error: On /stats, after a successful load, a failed request for a new range leaves the old range's '<n> harvests from ... to ...' summary line visible next to the error; triggered by making the next stats request fail after changing dates.
issues.harvest-stats/stats-no-timeout: On /stats, a stats request that never answers leaves 'Loading stats…' on screen indefinitely (often above the previous range's results) with no timeout or error; triggered by making /api/stats/harvests hang and opening the page or changing a date.
issues.harvest-stats/raw-validation-message: On /stats, an invalid date (e.g. ?from=2026-02-30 or a five-digit year) shows the raw validation text 'Query.from: Input should be a valid date or datetime…' and the date input appears blank; triggered by opening such a URL or typing such a date.
issues.harvest-stats/malformed-response-crash: On /stats, a 200 response with a malformed, non-JSON, empty or null-field body throws an uncaught TypeError, leaving the page stuck on 'Loading stats…' over old data (or not rendering at all on client navigation); triggered by mocking /api/stats/harvests with such a body and changing a date or navigating to Stats.
issues.harvest-stats/malformed-response-renders: On /stats, a stats response with null or missing fields renders as 'undefined/null harvests from – to –' with empty sections instead of an error state; triggered by mocking /api/stats/harvests with null fields.
issues.harvest-stats/blank-date-silent-default: On /stats, clearing the From or To field drops the parameter so the server silently uses this year's 1 Jan or 31 Dec, leaving the field blank while results use another range or showing 'The From date must be on or before the To date.'; triggered by clearing a date field, especially with the other date outside this year.
issues.harvest-stats/stats-no-retry-after-error: On /stats, the error state shows only a message with no Retry button, so recovering requires changing a date or reloading; triggered by making /api/stats/harvests fail.
issues.harvest-stats/empty-months-omitted: On /stats, the weight-by-month table only has columns for months with harvests, so empty months in the chosen range are silently skipped; triggered by choosing a range that includes months without harvests.
issues.harvest-stats/long-plant-name-narrow-lay: On /stats at 375 px width, a long unbroken plant name is truncated in Best plants and the nowrap table row header pushes all month and total columns out of view (or makes the page scroll sideways); triggered by creating a plant with a very long name and viewing the page on a narrow screen.
issues.harvest-stats/dashboard-top-plant-ambigu: On the dashboard, the 'Top plant this year' card shows only the plant name and links to /stats, so same-named plants cannot be told apart; triggered by having two plants with the same name and viewing the dashboard.
issues.harvest-stats/date-fields-ignore-url-cha: On /stats, the date fields are read from the URL only at setup, so clicking the Stats nav link or using back/forward while on the page changes the URL but not the fields or data; triggered by picking a custom range and then navigating to /stats within the app.
issues.plant-journal/hx3: On the plant detail page, when deleting a journal entry fails, the error is shown but the entry is removed from the list anyway, although it is still saved and returns on reload.
issues.plant-journal/hx4: In the plants list and on the plant detail page, a plant's harvest count and harvested weight are multiplied by its number of journal entries because the journal join is not de-duplicated.
issues.plant-journal/create-retry-duplicate-ent: POST /api/journal has no idempotency key or dedupe, so retrying Add entry on the plant page after a lost or timed-out response creates a duplicate entry.
issues.plant-journal/feed-long-plant-name-overf: On /journal at 375 px, a long unbroken plant name in the feed item link has no wrapping rule and makes the page scroll sideways.
issues.plant-journal/long-search-raw-validation: Typing more than 80 characters into the /journal search box (no maxlength) makes the API return 422 and the page replaces results with a raw 'String should have at most 80 characters' message.
issues.plant-journal/malformed-journal-response: When GET /api/journal returns a non-list body (object, string, HTML), the Journal page or plant journal section shows blank '–' entries or an empty/no-match state instead of a load error.
issues.plant-journal/plant-journal-capped-500: The plant detail journal fetches at most 500 entries with no paging or notice, so older entries are unreachable while the badge shows the full count.
issues.plant-journal/journal-requests-no-timeou: Journal fetches and mutations set no timeout, so when the API hangs the Add/Save button stays disabled on 'Saving…' or /journal stays on 'Loading entries…' indefinitely.
issues.plant-journal/control-chars-accepted-in-: POST /api/journal accepts and stores control characters such as an embedded NUL in the entry text, which are later rendered in the feed.
issues.plant-journal/implausible-old-dates-acce: POST/PUT /api/journal accepts implausible dates such as 0001-01-01, which are then shown as '1 Jan 1'.
issues.plant-journal/search-case-sensitive-non-: Journal search uses plain SQLite LIKE, so searching 'église' does not match an entry containing 'Église'.
issues.plant-journal/journal-load-error-no-retr: When GET /api/journal fails, the /journal page and the plant detail journal section show only 'Could not load the journal.' with no Retry control, requiring a reload or search edit to recover.
issues.plant-journal/out-of-range-id-500: Journal endpoints (POST plant_id, GET ?plant_id=, PUT/DELETE /api/journal/{id}) return 500 instead of 4xx when given integers larger than 64 bits.
issues.plant-journal/search-results-capped-50-m: A /journal search matching more than 50 entries says '50 entries match' and silently drops the rest.
issues.plant-journal/today-timezone-mismatch: The form defaults and limits the date to the browser's local today but the server validates against its own date.today(), so a user in a timezone ahead of the server gets 'Journal date cannot be in the future.' for today.
issues.plant-journal/body-limit-counts-utf16-un: The journal entry form's maxlength and character counter count UTF-16 units, so emoji count double (about 250 fit) and server-accepted 500-emoji entries cannot be edited and saved.
issues.plant-journal/delete-of-missing-entry-er: Deleting an entry that is already gone (second tab or retried delete) returns 404 'Journal entry not found.' as an error and the stale entry stays listed because the list only refreshes on success.
issues.plant-journal/failed-refresh-after-add-h: On the plant page, if adding an entry succeeds but the following journal refresh fails, the whole list is replaced by a load error with no retry while the badge count increases.
issues.plant-journal/search-no-debounce-stale-r: The /journal search fires a request per keystroke with no debounce, so on a slow network an older response can overwrite newer results.
issues.plant-journal/search-box-not-synced-with: On /journal?q=tom, clicking Journal in the nav or using back/forward changes the URL but the search box and results keep the old query.
issues.plant-journal/null-fields-rendered-raw: When API fields are null, the plants list shows 'null journal entries' and journal feed items render with empty plant name and body and only '–' as date.
issues.plant-journal/nul-body-500: POST/PUT /api/journal with a body starting with or consisting of a NUL character returns 500 because the SQLite length CHECK fails with an unhandled IntegrityError.
issues.plant-journal/edited-label-missing-same-: Editing a journal entry within the same second it was created shows no 'edited' label because timestamps have one-second resolution.
issues.watering-log/hx5: At 375px wide, the Record past watering form on /beds keeps its three-column grid, so the Date and Litres inputs shrink to about 30px and their values cannot be seen or edited.
issues.watering-log/hx6: On /waterings, choosing a bed writes ?bed_id= to the URL but the page reads only ?bed=, so reloading or opening that link shows all beds again.

issues.watering-log/beds-load-error-silent-in-f: On /waterings, when GET /api/beds fails the error is ignored and the Bed select silently offers only 'All beds' with no message or retry.
issues.watering-log/boolean-litres-accepted: POST /api/waterings with litres set to JSON true returns 201 and stores 1 litre instead of a 422.
issues.watering-log/boolean-bed-id-accepted: POST /api/waterings with bed_id set to JSON true returns 201 and records the watering on bed 1 instead of a 422.
issues.watering-log/no-request-timeout: Watering API calls have no timeout, so when the server hangs, 'Water now'/'Save watering' stay disabled on 'Watering…'/'Saving…' and lists stay loading indefinitely instead of failing after 10 s.
issues.watering-log/year-one-date-accepted: The past-watering form and POST /api/waterings accept implausible dates such as 0001-01-01, which are saved and listed as '1 Jan 1'.
issues.watering-log/watering-load-error-no-retr: When GET /api/waterings fails, the /waterings page and the dashboard 'Recent waterings' section show only an error message with no retry control, so recovery requires a reload or filter change.
issues.watering-log/huge-int-id-500: Watering endpoints (POST bed_id, GET ?bed_id=, DELETE /{id}) return 500 instead of 4xx for integers beyond 64 bits because SQLite overflows.
issues.watering-log/nonfinite-litres-500: POST /api/waterings with litres NaN, Infinity or an overflowing number like 1e309 returns 500 instead of a 422 validation error.
issues.watering-log/waterings-page-crash-non-ar: When GET /api/waterings returns a non-array body, /waterings throws 'waterings.value?.reduce is not a function', navigation stalls or the page sticks on loading, and no error is shown.
issues.watering-log/dashboard-non-array-shown-e: When the dashboard's GET /api/waterings?limit=5 returns a non-array object, 'Recent waterings' shows the 'No waterings yet' empty state instead of an error.
issues.watering-log/dashboard-malformed-never-r: When the dashboard's recent-waterings response is a malformed non-list (e.g. a string), the table renders rows reading 'Never' with blank bed and '–' amount and no error.
issues.watering-log/watering-ids-reused: Watering ids use INTEGER PRIMARY KEY without AUTOINCREMENT, so after deleting the newest watering a new one reuses its id and a stale DELETE could remove it.
issues.watering-log/create-not-idempotent: POST /api/waterings has no idempotency key or dedupe, so retrying 'Water now' or 'Save watering' after a lost or timed-out response records a duplicate watering.
issues.watering-log/double-click-water-now-dupl: Clicking 'Water now' twice quickly on /beds sends two POSTs before the button disables and records two waterings.
issues.watering-log/delete-retry-404-error: On /waterings, retrying a Delete whose first request already succeeded returns 404 'Watering not found.' and shows an error instead of being treated as done.
issues.watering-log/unknown-bed-select-mismatch: Opening /waterings?bed=<nonexistent id> shows 'No waterings for this bed' while the Bed select shows 'All beds', so filter control and results disagree.

issues.watering-log/tiny-litres-shown-0l: Litre amounts below 0.005 (e.g. 0.001) are accepted by the form and API but displayed as '0 L' in notices, the dashboard and /waterings.
